name: hGears AG
summary: Operating as a global specialist, hGears AG excels in the development, manufacturing, and provision of precision components, sub-systems, and comprehensive system solutions. Its portfolio encompasses a wide array of items, such as gears, sprockets, shafts, structural elements, and complete gearbox units. These critical parts find widespread application in e-bikes, electric and hybrid vehicles, alongside e-drive power and gardening tools. Established in 1958, the firm is headquartered in Schramberg, Germany.
